text.tspan: Employment rates: modeled vs. national estimates
Share of the working-age population who are employed. National estimates are based on each country's own
data collection and definitions, while modeled estimates are produced by the International Labour Organization
(ILO) using statistical methods to improve comparability across countries and over time.
Data source: Labour Force Statistics, via World Bank (2026); ILO Modelled Estimates, via World Bank (2026)
Note: Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming.
